title: KnowledgeBaseDocumentMetadata
description: Schema for the per-document JSON sidecars in poc/data/knowledge_base/metadata/. Chunk-level metadata in ChromaDB derives from this (with `page` added per chunk).

doc_id.description: Stable identifier for the document (defaults to PDF filename stem).

source.description: Original PDF filename (used for the citation download URL).

source_path.description: Path to the source PDF at ingestion time.

page.description: Chunk-only: 1-indexed page number this chunk came from.

pages.description: Chunk-only: comma-separated page numbers when a chunk spans more than one page (e.g. "3,4").

section.description: Chunk-only: deepest non-empty header text, verbatim (e.g. "1. Refund Policy", "**2. Theft & Incident Handling**").

section_title.description: Chunk-only: section header with markdown formatting and leading numbering stripped (e.g. "Refund Policy", "Theft & Incident Handling"). Use as the primary topical anchor for semantic search filters - stable across documents regardless of numbering.

chunk.description: Optional: chunk text. Normally stored as Chroma document content, not in metadata.

vector.description: Optional: embedding vector. Normally stored as Chroma embedding, not in metadata.
